name: Automation Registry Sync
description: This is the helper that keeps this whole list up to date. Every 5 minutes it quietly checks each automation running on the server -- whether it's on, when it last ran, and what it did -- and refreshes the cards you see here. In short: it's a self-running 'refresh' that makes sure what you see in this menu matches what's actually happening behind the scenes. You don't need to touch it.
